We need to parse problem (Arabic). Ali has four bills of $10 and six bills of $20, total after his work with Mr James at his farm. So total money = 4*10 + 6*20 = 40 + 120 = 160 dollars.

Ali gives his sister half of the total money he has. So he gives away 160/2 = 80. Remaining = 80.

He uses 3/5 of the remaining money to buy dinner. So dinner cost = (3/5)*80 = 48. After buying dinner, remaining money = 80 - 48 = 32.

Thus final amount = 32 dollars.
